unrecognized subcommand 'no-such-subcommand'

Manage registered vaults

Usage:
  gage vault [command]

Available Commands:
  list         List registered vaults
  info         Show a vault's type, method, recipient count, and (for git) remote/status
  remove       Forget a vault locally, leaving its files untouched
  set-default  Change which vault is used when none is given

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
